data.body: [P2] Drain late completions before fixing the invocation end time. The Invocation and terminal Workflow/root spans have already ended above, but this flush accepts checkpoint updates arriving during `forceFlush()`. Those updates create operation spans ending after the already-ended invocation, violating the span-containment invariant. Keep parent spans open until completion draining is quiescent, then end them and perform a final provider flush. Apply the same ordering to `InvocationOtelPlugin` and add a blocked-flush timestamp test.
